canonical_statement: Let X be a countable iid family of measurable-space-valued random variables on a probability space. Every measurable path event invariant under every finite-support permutation of the coordinates has pullback probability zero or one.
domain_and_universes: universes u v; Omega : Type u and E : Type v with measurable spaces; probability measure mu on Omega; X : Nat -> Omega -> E; event : Set (Nat -> E); Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: forall i j : Nat, IdentDistrib (X i) (X j) mu mu
MeasurableSet event in the product measurable space
event membership is invariant under every permutation sigma for which {n | sigma n != n} is finite
conclusion: mu (processPath X preimage event) = 0 or mu (processPath X preimage event) = 1
